name: Winged Sentinel
descr: Play the Winged Sentinel if you want to take flight and strike crushing blows from the sky.

foundations.name: Wings of Light
foundations.text:
You can fly. While flying, you can do the following:

- **Mark a Stress** to pick up and carry another willing creature approximately your size or smaller.
- **Spend a Hope** to deal an extra **1d8** damage on a successful attack.

specializations.name: Ethereal Visage
specializations.text: Your supernatural visage strikes awe and fear. While flying, you have advantage on Presence Rolls. When you succeed with Hope on a Presence Roll, you can remove a Fear from the GM's Fear pool instead of gaining Hope.

masteries.name: Ascendant
masteries.text: Gain a permanent +4 bonus to your Severe damage threshold.

masteries.name: Power of the Gods
masteries.text: While flying, you deal an extra **1d12** damage instead of 1d8 from your "Wings of Light" feature.
